fields.name: gallery
fields.label: Gallery image
fields.description: The photo strip under the board, across the full width. Optional.

fields.name: emptyMessage
fields.label: No results message
fields.description: Shown when no job matches the search and filters, e.g. No roles match your search.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: The heading's first line, in grey, e.g. OPEN ROLES AT.

fields.name: headingEmphasis
fields.label: Heading (second line)
fields.description: The heading's second line, in black, e.g. JSW MOTORS.

fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: Search input placeholder
fields.description: Shown inside the empty search box, e.g. Search Roles.

fields.name: filterLabel
fields.label: Filters label
fields.description: Above the dropdowns, e.g. Filter Roles.

fields.name: locationLabel
fields.label: Location dropdown label
fields.description: Shown in the dropdown while no location is chosen (it then lists every location), e.g. Locations.

fields.name: locations
fields.label: Locations
fields.description: The location dropdown's choices: add, edit, reorder or remove them here, e.g. Bangalore, India. A choice shows the jobs whose Job location is the same (or starts with it: Mumbai also shows Mumbai, India). Left empty, the dropdown lists the jobs' own locations.

fields.name: departmentLabel
fields.label: Department dropdown label
fields.description: Shown in the dropdown while no department is chosen (it then lists every department), e.g. Departments.

fields.name: departments
fields.label: Departments
fields.description: The department dropdown's choices: add, edit, reorder or remove them here. A choice shows the jobs whose Department is the same. Left empty, the dropdown lists the jobs' own departments.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Job title
fields.description: Up to 64 characters. The board shows up to 15 jobs (the first 15 in the content tree).

fields.name: department
fields.label: Department
fields.description: Shown under the title; one of the Filters' departments (written the same way), e.g. Hardware and Embedded Engineering.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Job location
fields.description: Shown with the pin; one of the Filters' locations, e.g. Bangalore, India. Several, separated by semicolons, for a job in more than one place: Mumbai, India; Pune, India.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Job description
fields.description: A short line under the department and location (up to 64 characters; the search also looks in it).

fields.name: applyLink
fields.label: Apply button link
fields.description: Where the button leads: a page, a URL or a mailto: address.
